title: PAH-OMC-025 route-independent minimal owner cut-set
question: Do the existing PAH-OMC-020 records reduce every admissible route to a common minimal cut-set of source semantics, comparison/target identification, and full-domain temporal control, without adding a new model or repeating a finite diagnostic?
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, the PAH-OMC-020 temporal preregistration, the PAH-OMC-025 contract and the six parent route records R-534, R-536, R-542, R-557, R-559 and R-564.
Audit S0 source semantics, the disjoint FORM_ROUTE and PATH_ROUTE alternatives for S1, and S2 full-domain temporal control against the exact parent scopes.
Reject partial routes, radial-only evidence, source-level nonuniqueness over-promotion and stationary-average-to-stopping-time promotion.
Run primary, independent, hostile and integrated replays and compile the finite Boolean cut-set theorem under the pinned Lean 4.32.1 toolchain.
finding: The existing route contracts admit one route-independent minimal cut-set: S0 source semantics and finite-generator identity, one complete S1 form or path comparison/target-identification route, and S2 full-domain temporal control in the original j-before-anchored-n quantifiers. The cut-set is explicit, but current records instantiate none of its three cuts; the actual PAH-OMC-020 route remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
decision_reason: This is a reusable auxiliary route-control advance that prevents repeating the same owner search, finite carrier calculations or abstract diagnostics. It does not advance the mainline because no source-authorized packet fills the cut-set.
boundary: PAH-001 functional, rates, state, carrier, external stochastic Markov time and j-before-anchored-n order are unchanged. No new carrier, counterterm, rate fitting, abstract oracle, physical projection or finite model is introduced. R-559 remains source-level only and R-564 remains a logical non-implication diagnostic.
verification_summary: Primary 42/42, independent 25/25, hostile 11/11, integrated 16/16, and Lean PASS under Lean 4.32.1 with eight finite declarations.

reproduction.lean: Set-Location verification/lean; lake env lean Tect/PahOmc025RouteFrontier.lean

next_action: Obtain one source-authorized, hash-pinned packet that instantiates S0 plus either complete S1 route and S2 without changing PAH-001 or its j-before-anchored-n order; do not repeat existing finite or abstract diagnostics.
revisit_condition: Reopen only when that owner packet is present or an exact unchanged-source contradiction to the route rule is found.
non_claims: This route-frontier synthesis is not PAH-OMC-020 convergence and is not a universal no-go for owner-fixed successors.
No common Hilbert space, path law, compensator, generator, carrier, rate, state, regulator or limit is constructed.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion; external Markov time remains stochastic bookkeeping.
